Look up user record where user id is record's created by.

Set Status to Awaiting Approval.
Update Status to Approved and ApprovalResult to Approved and Approve Time to CurrentTime.
Send Email to requester for the approval result.
Set approver to Beth Anglin.
Update Status to Rejected, ApprovalResult to Rejected and set Reject Reasom to "Insufficient stock" and Approve Time to CurrentTime.
Look up inventory record which is available.
Set the result record request No. to computer request number.
Ask approver for approval.
